system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: A middleware layer injects `agent.md` into every model call, so the agent always has full context of prior work without re-reading files.
system_prompt_style.note: Composed from middleware (agent.md injection, skill loading); prompt file not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: A middleware layer injects `agent.md` into every model call

context_compaction.evidence_quote: automatically offloads large tool results to the workspace filesystem, keeping a short preview in context, and compacts long conversations as they grow — summarizing older turns

observation_format.evidence_quote: downloads content from the sandbox or URLs, and injects it as base64 into the conversation for direct visual interpretation

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the agent writes and executes code inside a [Daytona](https://www.daytona.io/) cloud sandbox that processes data locally and returns only the final result
tool_call_format.note: Native tool calls via LangChain plus execute_code PTC.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: If the server restarts, subagent state is automatically reconstructed from its last checkpoint.

replayability.evidence_quote: On reconnect, up to 150,000 buffered events replay so the client picks up exactly where it left off.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Every tool output is scanned before it reaches the LLM context.
